candidate-01.hypothesis_en: Two narrow exception-priority clarifications on the unchanged confirmed-stage policy: a repeated category/location label in otherwise equivalent generic marketing is not a concrete product record without an independent product-specific fact or changed offer term; and a covered stock-cookie paragraph does not acquire an additional category-specific necessity obligation from its new heading alone. Actual products/specifications, transaction destinations, named liability, explicit category terms, concrete deployment restrictions and substantive body languages remain protected. Previous broad descendants mixed UI/failed-target/class-instance rules and had format failures; this isolates their approved cookie-scope clarification on the original stable stage parent, without transplanting those other rules. Actual prior main replies explicitly bypassed allowed provider exceptions by labeling them content additions, and a coverage reply acknowledged shared copy yet invented a new category obligation. Preserve all native fields/order/enums, response contract, evidence, model, sampling, executor and strict validator. First screen original hard presentations plus separately frozen cookie-scope positive/negative controls; no long inference solely to retry a failure.

The new semantic screen again has correct main decisions followed by those false coverage vetoes. All retention-policy paragraphs, main prompts/rubric, field names/types/enums, schema, validator, quoted evidence, critic veto authority, source presentation, model and sampling stay unchanged. This observation is not proof of causality: verify actual emitted order and native validity, then compare hard screens and separate cookie controls. Reject if order is ignored or technical validity worsens; do not repeat failed groups to select a lucky sample.
